example.prompt: Add a hat to this cat.

400.description: Bad request. The request is invalid or an invalid API key is provided.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. There are missing fields in the request body.

summary: Edit an image based on a prompt. This is the endpoint for making edit requests to image generation models.

oneOf.description:
Aspect ratio of the output image for image editing with multiple images.
For single image editing, do not set this. It will always auto-detect from the input image.
Input image to perform edit on. Mutually exclusive with `images`.

images.description:
List of input images for multi-reference editing.
Mutually exclusive with `image`. When multiple images are provided,
refer to them as \<IMAGE_0\>, \<IMAGE_1\>, etc. in the prompt.

n.description: Number of image edits to be generated.

oneOf.description:
Resolution of the generated image. Defaults to `1k`.
Only supported by grok-imagine models.

response_format.description: Response format to return the image in. Can be `url` or `b64_json`. If `b64_json` is specified, the image will be returned as a base64-encoded string instead of a url to the generated image file.

oneOf.description:
Optional output storage configuration. When present, the generated
image(s) are stored in the Files API and a `file_output` reference is
returned in the response alongside the ephemeral URL.

user.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help xAI to monitor and detect abuse.

data.description: A list of generated image objects.

oneOf.description: Billing and cost information for this request.

ImageAspectRatio.description:
Aspect ratio for image generation.
Only supported by grok-imagine models.

ImageUrl.description:
Image input for generation and editing requests.
Accepts a public URL, a base64-encoded data URL, or a file_id from the xAI Files API.

file_id.description:
File ID from the xAI Files API. Mutually exclusive with `url`.
The file must be an image (JPEG, PNG, or WebP) and fully uploaded.

url.description:
Public URL or base64-encoded data URL of the image (JPEG, PNG, or WebP).
Also accepts `image_url` for compatibility.
Required when `file_id` is not set.

ImageResolution.description:
Resolution for image generation.
Only supported by grok-imagine models.

StorageOptions.description:
Configuration for storing generation output in the Files API.
When provided in a generation request, the output is stored as a
permanent file and a `file_output` reference is included in the response.

expires_after.description:
Seconds from now until the file auto-expires. Maximum 2592000 (30 days).
If omitted, the file does not expire.

oneOf.description:
`true` = create public URL with default options (no independent expiry).
Object = create public URL with explicit configuration.
Omit = no public URL (file stored privately).

b64_json.description: A base64-encoded string representation of the generated image (without the data-URI prefix), if `b64_json` is specified as `response_format` in the request.

oneOf.description:
Storage info for the generated image. Only present when the request
included a `storage_options` configuration and the upload succeeded.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the generated image (e.g. `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/webp`).

storage_error.description:
Human-readable error when `storage_options` was set but the upload
failed. Absent on success or when storage was not requested.

url.description: A url to the generated image, if `response_format` is not specified or with `url` in the request.

MediaUsage.description:
Billing and cost information for media generation requests (image and video).

The optional token fields follow the OpenAI Images API shape
(`input_tokens` / `output_tokens` / `total_tokens` with per-side detail
objects) and are populated only for image models with token-based usage
reporting. They are omitted entirely for models billed per image and for
video requests.

cost_in_usd_ticks.description:
The cost of this request expressed in USD ticks.
One USD cent equals 100,000,000 ticks, so one US dollar equals
10,000,000,000 ticks.

input_tokens.description:
Total input tokens: prompt text tokens + input image tokens
(the sum of `input_tokens_details`, where `cached_tokens` is a subset
of `text_tokens`, not additive).

output_tokens.description:
Total output tokens: rewritten-prompt text tokens + reasoning tokens
+ generated image tokens (the sum of `output_tokens_details`).

PublicUrlInput.description:
Accepts either `true` (create public URL with defaults) or a configuration
object with explicit options.

**Variant order matters for `#[serde(untagged)]`:** `Flag` must come before
`Options` so that JSON `true`/`false` match `Flag` rather than falling
through to the object variant.

**Serialization note:** Proto→REST readback always constructs
`Options(...)`, never `Flag`, so responses always emit the object form.
`Flag` only appears on the deserialization (request) path.

oneOf.description:
`true` = create public URL with default options (no independent expiry).
`false` = no public URL (equivalent to omitting the field).

FileOutput.description: Information about a generated file stored in the Files API.

expires_at.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds) when the stored file expires and will be
automatically deleted. Only present when the file has an expiration.

file_id.description: Files API file_id of the stored file.

public_url.description:
Public URL for the stored file. Only present when the request included
`storage_options.public_url` and creation succeeded.

public_url_error.description:
Human-readable error when `storage_options.public_url` was set but
public URL creation failed. The file was stored successfully.

public_url_expires_at.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds) when the public URL expires. Present when
the public URL has an expiry, either from an explicit `expires_after`
in the request or inherited from the file's TTL.

MediaInputTokensDetails.description: Breakdown of media generation input tokens.

cached_tokens.description:
Text tokens served from cache from previous requests (a subset of
`text_tokens`).

image_tokens.description: Input image tokens, as reported by the image engine.

text_tokens.description:
Prompt text tokens consumed by the prompt-rewriting (upsampler) LLM,
including any served from cache.

MediaOutputTokensDetails.description: Breakdown of media generation output tokens.

image_tokens.description: Generated image tokens, as reported by the image engine.

reasoning_tokens.description:
Reasoning (thinking) tokens generated by the prompt-rewriting
(upsampler) LLM.

text_tokens.description:
Rewritten-prompt text tokens generated by the prompt-rewriting
(upsampler) LLM, excluding reasoning tokens.

PublicUrlOptions.description: Configuration for creating a public URL alongside file storage.

expires_after.description:
Seconds from now until the public URL expires. Must be between
3600 (1 hour) and 2592000 (30 days).

If omitted and the file has a TTL (`expires_after` on the file),
the public URL inherits the file's expiry. If omitted and the file
has no TTL, the public URL remains valid indefinitely until the
file is deleted or the URL is explicitly revoked via
`POST /v1/files/{file_id}/public-url/revoke`.
